A synthetic height-like growth measure. No brain data.

```{r}
library(referent)
set.seed(1)
ref <- norm_simulate(400, kind = "gaussian_scale")
spec <- norm_spec(
  family = norm_gaussian(),
  location = ~ s(age, k = 8) + sex,
  scale = ~ s(age, k = 5)
)
fit <- norm_fit(spec, data = ref, outcomes = "y")
val <- norm_simulate(150, kind = "gaussian_scale", seed = 2)
assessment <- norm_assess(fit, newdata = val)
assessment$overall
```
